title: Basic Pharmacy Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in Basic Pharmacy Technician
outcomes: Graduates will demonstrate pharmaceutical knowledge, clinical skills, and values necessary to practice as a competent pharmacy technician in both community/retail and hospital pharmacy settings.
Graduates will demonstrate competency with advanced-level clinical skills in accordance with ASHP/ACPE accreditation requirements.

notes: Catalog prints AHS 50A and PHT 64A; closed list stores them as AHS 050A and PHT 064A (same courses, zero-padded), so they are not marked as catalog additions.
PHT 63 (PTCE Review, 2 units) is not in the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
The 'or AHS 51' row prints no units beside it in this section; AHS 51 is printed as 1.5 units in the Pharmacy Assistant certificate section.
Units are quarter units; 19.5 quarter units fits the award band of 12Q to fewer than 24Q.

The outcomes list (heading cut off as 'arning Outcomes') is printed once for the Pharmacy Technician program as a whole; recorded as shared by this award. The second outcome references advanced-level ASHP/ACPE skills and may apply mainly to the Advanced-Level certificate/AS.
Career Opportunities text lists work settings (community/retail pharmacies, hospitals, home health care, etc.) for pharmacy technicians; only the job title 'Pharmacy technician' recorded as a career.

Program prerequisites (BIOL 14, Intermediate Algebra, PHT 200L) are listed for program admission and are not recorded as certificate requirements; the 90-unit figure applies to the associate degree, not this certificate.
